subject: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop and calendar availability
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lee <sabrina.lee@stellarpayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap & request: dedicated capacity sizing workshop

Hi Sabrina — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Objective: surface expected throughput and latency SLOs for your checkout and fraud scoring flows so we can size a Dedicated GPU pool and propose autoscaling/burst settings.
- Info we still need before the sizing call: 1) avg + peak requests per minute, 2) typical sequence lengths per request (prompt + expected assistant tokens), 3) latency SLO (p50/p95 targets), 4) whether on-prem/VPC required, and 5) any data residency constraints.

Can we schedule a 60-minute sizing workshop next week with your infra lead and our infra engineer (Ben) to walk through traffic patterns and load testing plan? My availability (PDT): Thu 31 Mar 10:00–12:00 or Fri 1 Apr 13:00–16:00. If none of those work, please propose two slots.

I've attached a small throughput worksheet you can fill out ahead of the call — it helps focus the session.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachments: throughput-estimate.xlsx
From: Sabrina Lee <sabrina.lee@stellarpayments.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellarpayments.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap & request: dedicated capacity sizing workshop

Thanks Sergio — great summary. I'm looping in procurement for scheduling too.

We can do Thu 31 Mar at 10:30 PT (30–90m ok) — that slot works for our infra lead, Marco. If that fills, Friday 1 Apr 14:00 PT is our backup.

I'll complete the throughput sheet with best-estimates and send prior to the call. A couple quick notes:
- Peak QPS is bursty during promo windows; we typically see 4–6x baseline for short bursts (5–10 minutes).
- Average sequence length will vary by model: customer-facing prompts ~120 tokens, internal scoring ~40 tokens.
- Data residency: US-only for now.

Sabrina
Head of Platform & Integrations
StellarPayments
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sabrina Lee <sabrina.lee@stellarpayments.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap & request: dedicated capacity sizing workshop

Looping in a couple of prep items for the workshop so we can make it actionable: 

- Ben: can you bring a short slide / checklist on what we need to run a short synthetic load test (client-side vs server-side drivers, test ramp profile)?
- Sergio / Sabrina: please confirm which model families you'll want to evaluate (open Llama variants, 70B quantized, or a hybrid of smaller + fallback). That affects GPU footprint and KV cache sizing.
- Sabrina: if you can drop a CSV of 24h request counts by minute (or a sample) that would be ideal; if not, 1-hour aggregates also work.

We can take the first 15 minutes to align scope, 35 minutes for traffic & test plan, and final 10 minutes for rollouts/next steps.

Thanks — we will come prepared.
Laura
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lee <sabrina.lee@stellarpayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@stellarpayments.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop — Thu 31 Mar 10:30 PT

Perfect — locked in Thu 31 Mar 10:30–11:30 PT. Calendar invite on its way (link below).

Quick logistics:
- Attendees from Redwood: Sergio (solutions), Ben (infra), Laura (SE).
- Requested from Stellar: Marco (infra), Sabrina (platform), someone from procurement if you want to cover contracting items.
- Pre-reads: I attached the throughput worksheet; also attaching an initial SOW draft so procurement has something to look at ahead of time.

If you need to reschedule, reply-all with proposed times. Otherwise we'll use the first 15 minutes to confirm the dataset you'll share and the last 10 minutes to agree on a minimal load test.

Sergio
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=capacity-workshop-4521
